initial_turn.subject: Looking for a quote on a few items for our store
initial_turn.body:
Hey there,

Hope you’re having a good day! I’m reaching out because we’re planning a little refresh for our kids’ section and snack area at Super Retail, and I’d like to get a quote for a few things before we move forward. I want to make sure we’re getting the right products and quantities, so here’s what I’m looking for:

- 2 sets of the JoySprout Toy Car Set (we’ve had a lot of parents asking about new toy cars, so I think these will go over well)
- 3 of the Pizza options (we want to offer a variety, but I’m not sure which ones are best for quick service—could you include the different types you have?)
- 6 bottles of Soda - Medium (these are always popular with our younger customers, so we want to keep them stocked)

If you need any more info from my side, just let me know. I’m hoping to get this sorted out pretty quickly so we can get the ball rolling. Thanks a ton for your help!

Best,
Mario Adams

Best regards,
Mario Adams
